name: @designme/astro-preview
description: Astro versions of the designme.dev components, generated from the site's HTML registry. Copy the files in src into your project (or use npx designme add <name> --astro); this package only generates them, writes their registry and builds every one in a test page.

scripts.registry: node scripts/registry.mjs && node scripts/bridge.mjs && node scripts/shadcn.mjs
